name: gregorian-trance
prompt: Gregorian chant meets trance music. A monastic loop discovers it has been a four-on-the-floor kick all along. Male choir drones in Latin fragments over a relentless pulse, 138 BPM. The chant and the kick are the same loop at different scales. Holy and mechanical, ancient and synthetic. The choir loops the way a sequencer loops; the sequencer chants the way a choir chants.
